_comment: Policy-as-data for wrappers/run_binary.py. Copy to binaries.json and edit.
ONLY put EASY-class binaries here: no flag that executes anything, no flag
that loads an external config file, and raw output that is already usable.
Everything else needs a real wrapper -- see wrappers/README.md. The runner
refuses dangerous flags even if a spec lists them, but that is a backstop,
not a licence to add hard-class binaries here.
allowedFlags is exact-match on the flag NAME (--opt=value is normalised),
so a flag not listed simply does not run. Positional args pass through.
